timer: CLOCK_MONOTONIC on POSIX; QueryPerformanceCounter on Windows
timer_resolution: host-dependent; not queried; batches are calibrated to at least 2 ms

timing_policy.warmup: one untimed warm-up operation per library/workload
timing_policy.calibration: powers-of-two batches until at least 2 ms, capped at 1,048,576 operations
timing_policy.accuracy_probes: one separate untimed deterministic probe after each timing batch
timing_policy.pair_order: counterbalanced in adjacent pairs; seed parity selects each block's starting library
timing_policy.wall_clock: monotonic wall-clock time; CPU time is not captured
timing_policy.summary: sample standard deviation; median by middle value or average of middle pair; p95 nearest rank ceil(0.95*n)
